svg.title: Platform and ore-sorting roadmap
svg.desc: P0 to P7 fixed-cell platform plan and S0 to S8 ore-sorting stages, with current status and dependencies.
svg.text: From a frozen baseline to a fixed cell
Approved 2026-11-28. No dates are promised; phases are ordered by dependency, not calendar.
Offline integration: CONDITIONAL · BASELINE 1 COMPLETE: NO · DEPLOYMENT READY: NO
Technical checks pass on the candidate tree; required PRs are unmerged. P1–P3 are the next evidence-producing phases.
P4 may run in parallel with P1–P3 (document-only). P5 stays gated until every AR5 identity fact has a source.
Mobile manipulation (P7) is deferred: jcheng-mobile stays Experimental and dormant. No dates are promised.
Source: approved platform-pivot record and ADR-0007 (2026-11-28); jcheng-scenarios PLATFORM_PIVOT_20261128.
